## Services

- [Web development](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/services/web-development): High-performance, scalable websites and web apps.
- [Application development](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/services/application-development): Native and cross-platform iOS and Android apps.
- [UI/UX design](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/services/ui-ux-design): Research-driven design systems and interfaces.
- [E-commerce solutions](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/services/e-commerce-solutions): Storefronts, marketplaces and payments.
- [Custom software development](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/services/custom-software-development): ERP, CRM and internal platforms.
- [AI development](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/services/ai-development): Generative AI, agents and workflow automation.
- [Data analytics](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/services/data-analytics): Business intelligence, predictive models and data engineering.
- [Support and managed services](https://www.codelixitsolutions.com/services/support-managed-services): Cloud migration, infrastructure and maintenance.
